༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgo nas nyams sublang

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang

ba bzhugs so// ya mā ri na mo/ 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro ni/ rgyas par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor ltar ram bsdu na skyabs sems blo dang 'dres par bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis/ dbyibs dang sngags dang rnal 'byor dang*// rnam dag ye shes zhes bya nas// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// zhes bzhir gsungs pa'i spyi don dang po dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gsum/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ snod bcud byin gyis brlab pa/ thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o/ */ dang po bdag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang*| zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus kho nas bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bstan to// gnyis pa snang srid byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khams gsum ma lus nas/ mtshan ma'i yul las 'das/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud gshin rje'i gshed/ sgra thams cad sngags/ srid gsum chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan/ dug gsum sku gsung thugs/ dug lnga ye shes lnga/ 'khor 'das dbyer med gshin rje'i gshed gzung 'dzin gyi yul las 'das pa pra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom mo// gsum pa thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad kyi dus kyang*/ phyi snang ba thams cad snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma 'ja' tshon lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa de lta bus nang sgyu lus lhar gsal ba la rgyas gdab/

nang sgyu lus lhar gdod nas yongs su grub/ snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bu des phyi snod bcud rten dang brten par gdod nas yongs su ma grub pa la rgyas gdab/ nang sgyu lus dang phyi snod bcud rten dang brten par gdod nas yongs grub rdzas dngos por ma grub pa spros pa'i mtshan ma dang bral ba'i sgyu ma lta bur nyin mo sbyangs pa mtshan mo'ang gnyid du 'gro khar don de nyid la ma yengs par blo bzhag nas 'khrul rtog gzhan gyi bar ma chod par nyams rmi lam dang 'od gsal gyi gdams pa gud nas btsal mi dgos so// 'di ni bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i bskyed rim gong bu'i rnam pa zab pa'i mthar thug pa dag go// spyi don gnyis pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la gnyis/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o// dang po rgyas pa la gsum/ srog rtsol gyi nges pa/ srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor/ srog rtsol gyi 'bras bu'o// dang po srog rtsol gyi nges pa ni/ lus can thams cad kyi lus dngos por 'dzin cing bskyed pa dang*/ bar du rnam shes kyis snon pa byas nas rnam rtog sna tshogs dang nad sna tshogs bskyed/ tha mar lus 'jig pa sogs thams cad kyi byed po rlung bcus dbang du byed pa'o// gnyis pa srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ sbyang ba/ bsgom pa/ 'jug pa gsum/ dang po sbyang ba la stan bde bar rdo rje'i skyil krung lag gnyis pus mgor bkab/ rang lus lhar gsal ba'i khong pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po/ yar sne spyi bo'i haṃ dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yar sne sna bug gnyis dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi dbu ma dang 'brel ba/ de gsum las gyes pa'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab bcu drug /mgrin par so gnyis/ snying gar brgyad/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi thams cad dkar hrim 'dug par bsgom/ de nas byā gh+ra keng sna bug nang nas rgyu ba ngos nas lan gsum slar mi rgyu ba ngos nas lan gsum/

mthar gnyis ka nas lan gsum rnams stag mo'i skyug stangs ltar snga mo dal bar snyoms tha ma drag cing yun ring bar 'bud do// de rjes bā rā ha zhes sna bug gnyis ka nas phag gi ngur sgra ltar sgra bcas su 'bud cing de dang lhod cing gru mo gnyis mchan khung du brdeb pa grangs ci rigs pa bya'o// de rjes mu sa la zhes pa 'og sgo gnyis lhod kyis lhod cing thur du mnan nas 'phongs gtun shing gis brdung ba ltar sa la lan ci rigs brdeb pa gsum lnga bdun sogs ci rigs bya'o// de gsum ni steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung ro bsal zhing sbyang ba'o// de rjes a tra ra zhes pa ste/ rlung drag tu brngub/ 'og rlung gnyis drag tu bsdam/ pho bar chun gcu dgang zhing lto bar steng 'og gi rlung khong par bkang nas lto ba g.yas skor gsum/ g.yon skor gsum/ mgo g.yas skor gsum/ g.yon skor gsum/ mgo bo rgyab mdun du bcag pa gsum gsum/ rkang lag bzhi mgo so sor phra zhing sprug pa gsum gsum/ lus kun la lag pas mnye zhing byug pa lan gsum rnams byas rjes rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag pa pus mgor bkab/ rlung phyir rdzogs par btang*/ de 'dra lan ci rigs pa byas rjes lha'i rnal 'byor gsal btab cing mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa de ni lus sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor dngos la gsum/ rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ tshe sgrub rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ yig gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// dang po rlung rdo rje bzlas pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ sna bug gi rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la sems ma yengs par gtad nas 'jug gnas dbyung gsum la grangs re re brtsi ba'i nyin dang mtshan du grangs rab nyis khri chig stong*/ 'bring drug brgya/ tha ma brgya phrag sogs grangs bzung la bsgom/ de 'dra ba nyin zhag nyer bdun gyi bar 'bad do// gnyis pa tshe sgrub rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/

nangs par bya rog sgra mi grag pa'i sngon du lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ sems tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs nas sna bug gi rlung gnas pa dang phyir rgyu ba mi bgrang bar nang du 'jug la stong phrag re thems par bgrang tshul de 'dra ba nang ma brgya phrag gcig byas pas rlung 'jug pa'i grangs 'bum thems par gyur pas nges par tshe zad pa'ang lo lngar the tshom med do// nang ma brgya phrag gcig po ma thems bar nangs re bzhin ma chag par stong thems nges gal che'o// gsum pa yig gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i dbu ma'i mar sne gsang gnas kyi gong lte 'og tsam rlung thams cad 'dres pa'i ngo bo a yig dngul chu lta bu la sems gtad nas sna bug gi rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ lte 'og tu gnas pa āḥ phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ gi rnam par kha nas 'don pa ma yin pa de ltar rlung gi rang sgras ci nus su 'bad cing bgrang*/ de bzhin du rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi sogs ngag 'don gyi bsrung ba'i dmigs pa kho na gsal bas hūm̐ yig la sems gtad nas ya ma bcu drug pa dang*/ a kro bcu bdun pa/ bcu gcig /las sbyor rtsa ba'i sngags rnams kyang ngag nas brjod pa spangs la rlung sems kho nas dag cing sgra ma chag par ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa bum can gyi rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro mnyam rgyu'i rlung gis 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bum pa can gyis 'chi med sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po mnyam rgyu'i rlung gis 'chi ba bslu ba ni/ sna bug g.yas kho na nas zhag bdun lnga gsum sogs mi 'pho bar rgyu na 'chi ltas yin pas gzhogs g.yas pa sar phab/ brla g.yon steng du g.yas pa bzhag /rkang mgo g.yon sgyid par bskyil/ dpung pa g.yas la ljid bkal/ sna bug g.yon mthe'u chung gis bkag /g.yas nas rlung khengs par brngubs/ 'og rlung 'then steng 'og kha sbyar la bzung/

slar mi bde ba med tsam gyi tshe sna bug g.yas mthe'u chung gis bkag /g.yon nas rdzogs par btang*/ de 'dra bas rlung sna bug g.yon du ma rgyu'i bar du bya/ yang 'chi ltas sna bug g.yon nas byung na g.yon 'og tu bcug pa sogs lus gnad dang rlung gnad g.yas pa'i dus las go log par bya'o// gnyis pa bum pa can gyi 'chi med sgrub pa la gsum/ bzhi sbyor bum pa can/ steng 'og bsre ba/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon shes sgrub pa'o// dang po bzhi sbyor bum can ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lag pa pus mor bkab la rlung ro bus/ sna bug gnyis nas khengs par brngubs/ de rjes kheng bar bya ba ni dgang ba'i sbyor ba/ lto ba khengs nas lte 'og tu hril gyis bkug pa ni bkug pa'i sbyor ba/ rgyab rlung yar 'then steng 'og byed pa ni dgug pa'i sbyor ba/ rlung mi thub tshe sna bug nas nang du rngub chung zhig byas lte 'og tu chil gyis gnon pa ni gzhil ba'i sbyor ba/ de nas mig nam mkhar bltas la sems rtog med du 'jog pa rengs pa'i sbyor ba/ nan ltar mi thub tshe rlung thams cad sna bug gnyis nas dal gyis btang sems rtog med du ye re bzhag go| |gnyis pa steng 'og bsre ba rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ gong ltar rlung kha sbyor bzung rjes steng rlung gsang gnas su mnan/ 'og rlung steng du drangs/ yang mar gsang bar mnan cing yar drangs| slar mar mnan nas yar drangs/ lte bar kha sbyor du bzhag nas spros med bsgom pa ni phyir mnan gsum/ yang lte rlung gsang bar gnan/ 'og rlung slar mar mnan yar drangs/ snying khar kha sbyor du bzhag nas spros med bsgom pa ni yar 'then gsum/ tshul de 'dra bar sbyangs pas steng 'og thur sel bsre ba'i man ngag dam pa'o// gsum pa mngon shes bsgrub pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po dri ma med pa 'od 'phro ba bsam/ rtag tu rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe rlung thams cad hūm̐ la thim par bsam/

gnyis pa rtags snang ni de ltar bsgoms pas rlung nang du brtan pa'i rtags 'dar ba dang*/ dran med du 'gro ba dang*/ lus tsha ba dang*/ zug pa dang*/ gzer ba dang*/ rma'i shul kun skrangs pa dang*/ 'khru skyug ci rigs pa 'byung*/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba dang po g.yas sa rlung zin pas du ba lta bu/ chu rlung zin pas smig rgyu lta bu/ me rlung zin pas srin bu me khyer lta bu/ rlung gi rlung zin pas mar me lta bu/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ nyi zla skar ma shar ba lta bu'i snang ba khra yal le ba sogs 'byung*/ slar bsgoms pas/ ri bo sna tshogs pa dang*/ shing ljon pa du ma dang*/ 'gro ba rigs mang po dang*/ lha'i sku du ma dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po dang*/ sgra du ma dang bcas pa brjod kyis mi lang ba du ma 'byung ngo*// gsum pa de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs su mngon par shes pa lnga thob pa dang mthar thug rdo rje 'chang gshin rje'i gshed 'grub pa'o| |gsum pa mjug 'pho ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro ni/ tshangs bug ma gtogs pa'i bu ga dgu hūm̐ sngon po re res bkag cing*/ tshangs bug tu rlung dang bsdongs nas ā li kā li'i yi ge mang pos 'gro 'ong byed par yang yang bsam/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba'o// dang po sbyang ba ni| rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgoms gsol ba btab/ de rjes rlung bum can bzung*/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma gsal ba'i snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag /lte ba'i thad du yaṃ gnyis rgyab sprod kha steng 'og tu bltas pa las/ rlung dkyil ljang gu zla gam brtsegs ma gnyis kyi steng du hik ces pa'i steng du sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing kha rnams gsal btab/ rlung bum pa can gsum bstud de bzung*/ tha ma'i tshe rlung phyir dbyung ba dang stabs cig tu ngag nas hika ྄drag po brjod pa'i rlung dmigs sems gsum steng du gtad pas rlung dkyil las rlung g.yos pas hika ྄྄phul/

hika ྄gis sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ phul/ hūm̐ des snying ga'i hūm̐ drag tu phul bas tshangs bug tu rgyangs se 'gro bar bsam/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe yi ge rnams mar log nas so so'i gnas su bab par bsam/ de lta bu lan nyer gcig sogs thun re la sbyang*/ 'byongs pa'i rtags spyi dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la gnyis/ 'chi ba bslu ba dang las sbyor dngos so// dang po 'chi ltas byung tshe 'chi ba bslu ba sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa las sbyor la'ang gnyis/ spros bcas dang spros med do// dang po spros bcas ni/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs sna tshogs byas kyang nges par 'chi ba'i rtags mthong na sngar sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa rnams gsal btab/ bum can bzung ba'i mthar hika ྄drag pos mtshams sbyar ba'i tshe rlung dkyil g.yos shing hika ྄la thim/ hika ྄drag tu g.yos pa sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ la thim ma thag hūm̐ skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar yar 'phros snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ma thag snying ga'i hūm̐ tshangs bug tu rgyangs kyis thon pa bla ma'i thugs kar ram gang 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sangs rgyas de'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ rlung mig sems gsum gyen du gtad/ rang gis hika ྄brjod mi nus na grogs kyis brjod pas kyang nges par 'pho'o// gnyis pa spros med kyi 'pho ba ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe sems rnam par mi rtog pa la bzhag cing 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi don las ma g.yos par 'chi ba'i dus byas pas shi ma thag chos skur 'pho'o// gnyis pa bsdus pa ni/ gong gi srog rtsol gyi gdams pa rgyas pa nyams su len mi nus na/ lus gnad snga ma lta bus mi rtog pa bsgom/ rtog pa 'phro na rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ bum pa can gang rung nyams su blang*/ mthar spyi bor bla ma sgom zhing 'pho ba cung zad re sbyang ba yin no// de rnams ni gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa steng sgo rnam par grol ba la ches zab pa'o// spyi don gsum pa bdag gi rnal 'byor ram dam tshig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la gnyis/

dam tshig gi rnal 'byor gyi nges pa/ de nyid bsgoms pas nyams su blang ba'o// dang po dam tshig gi rnal 'byor gyi nges pa ni/ thabs shes snyoms 'jug gi nyams len gyis srid pa'i chags bde bcom ste mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba nyams su blang ba'o// gnyis pa dam tshig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba dngos la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis/ rlung steng 'og so sor sbyang ba dang*/ kha sbyor du sbyang ba'o// dang po steng 'og so sor sbyang ba ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ rnams dmigs nas steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung rang sor bzhag /dmigs pa ni/ dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ rdo rje nor bu'i bu gar 'od kyi gong bu 'khyil ba la sems gtad/ yang 'od zer dbu ma nas mar brgyud snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam steng rlung phyir btang*/ 'og rlung yar drag tu bsdams la/ rdo rje nor bu'i bu ga'i 'od zer yang dbu ma nas brgyud/ dpral ba'i oṃ dang snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ yang rgyab rlung 'dor ro// gnyis pa rlung kha sbyor du sbyang ba ni/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung la yar steng du drangs/ mar 'og tu mnan/ lte bar kha sbyor du bya/ dmigs pa yi ge rnams gong ltar bsgoms la/ dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ nor bu'i bu gar spros/ yang nor bu'i 'od zer yar spyi bo'i oṃ dang dpral ba'i haṃ la bstim/ mthar dpral bar shes pa drag tu gtad do| |'di ni man ngag yang dag pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rang lus dang*/ gzhan lus so// dang po rang lus thabs ldan ni/ dmigs pa dang rlung dang phyag rgya gsum gyis nyams su blangs te bla ma'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhan lus thabs ldan ni/ phyag rgya brtags shing de nyid dbang gis smin par bya/

de nyid dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi dbye bas bsten lugs so sor bya zhing*/ thams cad la rlung dmigs dbab bzung sgyogs 'dren 'grem pa'i sbyor ba bya ste/ 'di'ang bla ma'i gsung gi gsang ba kho na las rtogs par byos shig /'di dag ni dbang gsum pa dang 'brel ba'i 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam shin tu zab pa'o// spyi don bzhi pa rnam dag ye shes kyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bsgom par bya ba dang*/ ngo sprad pa'o// dang po bsgom bya ni/ sngar bshad pa'i dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gyi snang stong zung 'jug /sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi grag stong zung 'jug /dam tshig gi rnal 'byor gyi bde stong zung 'jug gsum bsgoms pas dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gyis snang ba la rang dbang 'thob/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis rlung la rang dbang 'thob/ dam tshig gi rnal 'byor gyis bde ba la rang dbang 'thob/ de gsum thob nas 'gyur med kyi bde ba la dmigs shing spros bral gyi rnal 'byor lus lha dang*/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos bzhin du de dag thams cad la der 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzang ngan thams cad bcom pas ma spangs/ legs pas ma bsgrubs/ bzang la mi re/ ngan la mi dogs/ bsam brjod shes rig gi yul thams cad dang bral ba 'od gsal stong pa chen po mtshan ma'i chos dang*/ spros pa thams cad las 'das pa de nyid rang ngo rang thog tu rang gshis lhod babs kyis ma yengs par dus rtag tu la zlo zhing nyams su blang bya blang byed bral ba la 'bad brtson dang ldan par bya'o// mdor dril na sngar rnal 'byor snga ma gsum nyams su blangs pa'i snang stong*/ grag stong*/ bde stong gsum ji lta ba nyams su myangs pa de'i myong ba skyong zhing goms pas klong du gyur cing bogs 'don pa'i rnal 'byor snga ma gsum gyi bogs 'don rtsal sbyong lta bu yin pas so// gnyis pa ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas snang ba'i chos nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs brnyan me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu snang ba'i stong gzugs 'di ni rtag pa'i dngos po ma yin te rdul phra rab las 'das pa/

chad pa'i rang bzhin ma yin te pra phab pa lta bur snang ba/ bdag shes rig gi skyes bu la sogs pa ma yin te spros pa dang bral ba/ de las gzhan pa ma yin te mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ srid par 'khor ba'i chos ma yin te rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba/ zhi ba chad pa'i myang 'das ma yin te gzhom du med pa'i snang ba thog mar skye ba med cing gdod nas dag pa dang rang byung ba/ dbus dang mtha' gcig tu'ang mi gnas par kun tu khyab pa/ tha mar 'gags pa med cing rtag pa ste skye 'gag gnas gsum rnam par spangs pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po de/ bsam pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa'i tshul gyis bsams nas de ltar sems pa po de ni rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur nges te/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis/ rtag pa ma yin chad pa min// bdag min gzhan yang ma yin pa// srid min mya ngan 'das pa min// thog ma dbus mtha' rnam par spangs// 'od gsal ba la de sems pa// de las rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi'i lam bsgoms pa las byung ba'i ye shes stong gzugs 'di ni phyag rgya chen po bsam du med pa zhes bya ste thabs shes dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin chos kyi dngos po kun nas dwangs pa ste/ dper na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam chu nang gi zla ba bzhin du gnas pa/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab cing 'od gsal bar snang ba 'gyur ba med pa'i mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin nyid kyi bde ba chen po stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa nyid dang*/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa las// gang skyes ye shes phyag rgya che// thabs dang shes rab rang gi dngos// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// 'jig rten khyab cing gsal bar snang*// mi 'gyur mchog gi bde ba che// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi// ye shes chen po 'grub 'gyur ro// ye shes sbyor ba zhes bya ste// rnal 'byor chen po'o zhes gsungs so// 'di ni dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i phyag rgya chen po bsam du med pa'i rig pa ches zab bo| |gsum pa mjug ni/
